body.en:
Police are investigating the death of a woman who was struck by a car that crashed into a restaurant at Westfield Knox in Wantirna South in Melbourne’s east.

Emergency services responded to reports of the crash at about 12.45pm on Monday, according to Ambulance Victoria .

The female customer, who has not yet been formally identified, died at the scene. A second customer was treated by paramedics at the scene.

The driver and passenger were both taken to Maroondah hospital in stable conditions.

Police have launched an investigation but said they “do not believe the incident was an intentional act”.

In a social media post, cafe Martini & Co said it was “temporarily closed until further notice”.

title.en: 130,000 or 230,000? The migration figures One Nation is trying to explain
title.zh: 13万还是23万？一国组织试图解释的移民数据

summary.en: Conflicting comments from One Nation figures have raised questions about the party's migration target.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce has faced questions over his party's immigration target, claiming fellow MP David Farley misspoke when he revealed their figures were "not too different" from Labor's.

The MP for Farrer told ABC's Insiders program on Sunday that One Nation's stated figure of 130,000 net overseas migration annually into Australia did not include those who enter under a Pacific labour scheme, aged-care nurses, and other in-demand skilled workers.

He conceded that those groups would add roughly 100,000 people, bringing their total to 230,000 — 5,000 fewer than the current Labor budget projections.

Party leader Pauline Hanson intervened just hours later, writing on social media that One Nation's policy is to reduce net overseas migration (NOM) to 130,000.

Speaking to Channel Seven's Sunrise program on Monday, Joyce added that Farley simply made a mistake while explaining the numbers.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Show me a political career where people haven't made a mistake, and I'll show you a person who's not told the truth," Joyce said.

"I'm not going to throw anybody under a bus. When people are new in parliament, they can sometimes get things incorrect, and that's what happens. God knows, I've done it enough."

The debate over Australia's migration figures has intensified in recent months, with a recent Redbridge/Accent Research poll, conducted for the Australian Financial Review, indicating that voters trust One Nation and its traditionally restrictive approach to handle migration better than Labor or the Liberal Party.

However, the disjointed nature of One Nation's ongoing public discourse on the topic has prompted claims that the party is "incoherent" and "not fit to govern" from federal minister Pat Conroy.

Since its 1997 inception, cutting immigration has been seemingly a foundational pillar of One Nation policy. During her first speech to federal parliament, Hanson alleged Australia was in danger of being "swamped by Asians", that migrants never assimilated, and that multiculturalism should be abolished.

Its website currently states One Nation would "cut immigration by over 570,000 people" through "capping visas at 130,000 per year".

In a social media post on Sunday, Hanson wrote that NOM would be cut to 130,000 — a figure the party has previously clarified to SBS News . This number would be achieved by reducing international students, temporary graduate visas, and a "much more targeted" skilled migration program, Hanson said.

Those figures are different to the ones put forward by Farley, who said One Nation is focusing on "the NOM in its true form", as separate to labour programs "that drive our...
body.zh: 一国党议员巴纳比·乔伊斯 (Barnaby Joyce) 面临有关该党移民目标的质疑，声称同僚议员戴维·法利 (David Farley) 在透露他们的数字与工党的数字“相差不大”时说错了话。 法雷尔议员周日告诉美国广播公司的 Insiders 节目，一国党公布的每年有 13 万名海外净移民进入澳大利亚的数字不包括根据太平洋劳工计划进入的人、老年护理护士和其他急需的技术工人。 他承认这些团体将增加大约 10 万人，使总人数达到 23 万人——比当前工党预算预测少 5,000 人。 几小时后，该党领导人保琳·汉森(Pauline Hanson)介入，她在社交媒体上写道，一国党的政策是将海外净移民(NOM)减少到13万人。 乔伊斯周一在第七频道的《日出》节目中补充说，法利只是在解释这些数字时犯了一个错误。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 乔伊斯说：“向我展示一个人们没有犯过错误的政治生涯，我就会向你展示一个没有说实话的人。” “我不会把任何人扔到公共汽车下。当人们刚进入议会时，他们有时会弄错事情，这就是发生的事情。上帝知道，我已经做得足够多了。” 近几个月来，有关澳大利亚移民数据的争论愈演愈烈，Redbridge/Accent Research 最近为《澳大利亚金融评论》进行的一项民意调查显示，选民相信一国党及其传统的限制性政策，能够比工党或自由党更好地处理移民问题。 然而，一国党持续就这一话题进行的公开讨论的脱节性质促使联邦部长帕特·康罗伊声称该党“语无伦次”且“不适合执政”。 自 1997 年推出以来，减少移民似乎一直是一国政策的基本支柱。汉森在联邦议会的第一次演讲中声称澳大利亚面临“被亚洲人淹没”的危险，移民永远不会被同化，多元文化主义应该被废除。 其网站目前表示，一国党将通过“每年 13 万个签证上限”来“减少超过 57 万移民”。 汉森在周日的社交媒体帖子中写道，NOM 将削减至 13 万人——该党此前已向 SBS 新闻澄清了这一数字。汉森表示，这一数字将通过减少国际学生、临时毕业生签证和“更有针对性”的技术移民计划来实现。 这些数字与法利提出的数字不同，法利表示，一国党正在关注“真正形式的 NOM”，与“推动我们……的劳工计划”分开。

summary.en: A second seal has contracted the virus in South Australia, as Phillip Island rushes to vaccinate its iconic bird population.

body.en:
Bird flu has likely spread to a second seal, one day after the first mammal in Australia was confirmed to have contracted the virus.

Five suspected H5 bird flu cases were recorded in South Australia on Monday, including a long-nosed fur seal at The Pages Conservation Park, the state's Department of Primary Industries and Regions said in a statement on Monday morning.

The Pages — which covers two small islands between Kangaroo Island and the mainland — is a haven for the endangered Australian sea lion.

The fur seal has been tested for bird flu, with results expected in the coming days.

The first positive case of the virus in a mammal was confirmed on Sunday in a long-nosed fur seal at Beachport, 300km south of Adelaide, which authorities believed was contracted from wild birds.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Before the new case was announced, Environment Minister Murray Watt said the spread from birds to mammals was inevitable and the government was examining whether further vaccination programs were needed.

"We are likely to see mass mortalities of birds and mammals, and I know that is a very distressing thing for Australians to hear. But we also need to be realistic," he told ABC TV on Monday.

"This is what we've seen happen overseas. Australia is very fortunate that we've been the last continent on Earth to have this strain of bird flu happen. But we are likely to see those kind of events as we have overseas."

Agriculture Minister Julie Collins said the federal government was investigating whether bird flu vaccines were available for use in mammals.

"There are trials underway in North America, in California and Hawaii, and this is using a vaccine that's been developed for cattle," she told ABC radio.

"There certainly is nothing commercially available, but we do continue to look at that research."

Bird flu vaccinations have been rolled out to at-risk species, including the little penguins on Victoria's Phillip Island.

Many were corralled into pens to receive the first of two vaccinations on Sunday night.

With case numbers on the rise, authorities have stepped in to do what they can to defend the 5,000-strong colony.

The penguins' nightly ritual of returning to the same burrow, along the same path, made them ideal candidates for vaccination, Phillip Island Nature Parks reserve manager Ben Thomas said.

As a world-first in scale, the process has taken some experimentation and fine-tuning.

"We've had our teams out late into the night for a week now and learning a lot along the process," Thomas said.

title.en: SBS WorldWatch is changing. Here's what viewers need to know
title.zh: SBS WorldWatch 正在发生变化。这是观众需要了解的内容

summary.en: The multilingual news service will cease broadcasting next month and continue exclusively online.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
SBS WorldWatch will soon become a digital-only service, ending its run as a broadcast television channel.

The multilingual news service, which provides news bulletins from international broadcasters, will move entirely to SBS On Demand .

SBS says the shift will allow it to increase the number of bulletins available in most languages.

From 18 September, the channel, which provides international news in 38 languages from 49 broadcasters worldwide, will cease broadcasting and all SBS WorldWatch programming will continue on SBS On Demand.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As the channel closes, SBS WorldWatch will expand its existing digital service over the coming weeks to include two or more daily bulletins in most languages.

This is more content than could be accommodated on a single linear channel, SBS says, allowing audiences to watch bulletins as soon as they become available rather than waiting for a scheduled broadcast.

SBS On Demand also features two 24-hour FAST channels for English-language news — Euronews and France 24 .

SBS Director of News and Current Affairs, Mandi Wicks, said SBS WorldWatch played an important role in connecting Australians with news and perspectives from around the world, in their preferred language.

"Moving to SBS On Demand gives us the opportunity to build on that service, with more international news bulletins and greater flexibility for audiences to decide when and how they watch," she said.

"We recognise this will be a change for some audiences who are accustomed to watching SBS WorldWatch on linear television. We're committed to supporting them through the transition, while continuing to evolve our services for the future."

SBS is providing multilingual information and guidance through SBS Audio language programs and on SBS WorldWatch channel 35 ahead of the change.

Further information is available here , with additional support available via the SBS Help Centre .

The SBS WorldWatch — News In-Language hub can be found on the SBS On Demand homepage , where audiences can also search for content in their preferred language.

The full SBS On Demand offering features more than 15,000 hours of local and international programming across more than 60 languages, spanning news and current affairs, documentaries, drama, world movies, entertainment, food, children’s content and sport.

This includes dedicated language collections, as well as selected English-language programs with subtitles in Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, and Vietnamese.

title.en: 'Second chance at life': Sydney woman speaks publicly after surviving shark attack
title.zh: “第二次生命机会”：悉尼女子鲨鱼袭击幸存后首次公开讲话

summary.en: Leah Stewart, 34, a Sydney mother, has spoken publicly for the first time since surviving a shark attack over two months ago, attributing her "remarkable" recovery to community support. She expressed gratitude for the "army of love, support, prayers and encouragement" that helped her "get better, not bitter."
summary.zh: 34岁的悉尼母亲莉亚·斯图尔特在两个多月前鲨鱼袭击中幸存后首次公开讲话，她将自己“显著”的康复归功于社区的支持。她对“来自世界各地的爱、支持、祈祷和鼓励大军”表示感谢，这些帮助她“变得更好，而不是心怀怨恨”。

body.en:
A Sydney mother has spoken publicly for the first time since surviving a shark attack more than two months ago, crediting community support with helping her "get better, not bitter".

In a post on her GoFundMe donation page, Leah Stewart, 34, said she still had a long way to go, but her recovery had been "remarkable".

"A huge part of that is because of the absolute army of love, support, prayers and encouragement surrounding my family and I from all over the world," she said.

"That means more to me than I can say, and I truly believe it’s played a huge role in my recovery."

Stewart was swimming between the flags close to shore when she was attacked by a great white shark at Coogee Beach on 13 June.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

She was rushed to hospital in a critical condition, being induced in a coma and undergoing multiple surgeries, including the amputation of one of her arms.

The mother of one said she had been focused on her recovery and had "progressed enough to build some independence, and I can finally see some light after all of this".

"I want you to know that I feel like I’ve been given a second chance at life, and I’m not going to waste it. As I get better, I know I’ll make something of this second chance and aim to give back even more in generosity, care, and love. I will forever be grateful for everything, and everyone, I’ve been given," she said.

Stewart thanked those who had contributed to the fundraiser, which had reached more than $558,000, but it was time to turn donations off.

"What you’ve offered has given us enough to recover, to stay in our home, and to give us options for further medical treatment down the road," she said.

Sydney has experienced a spate of shark attacks this year, including three in just 48 hours in January.

On 18 January, 12-year-old Nico Antic was critically injured and later died after being attacked by a suspected bull shark while swimming off rocks in Vaucluse in Sydney Harbour.

The following day, Andre de Ruyter, 27, was attacked while surfing near Manly, suffering extreme blood loss and undergoing surgery to have one of his legs amputated.

An 11-year-old boy's surfboard was also bitten at Dee Why Beach on the same day, but the young surfer escaped injury.

After Stewart was attacked in June, NSW Premier Chris Minns said his government would invest an extra $34 million in drone coverage across NSW beaches.

title.en: Enosh has a 10-year, $600,000 bet on the Australian dream
title.zh: Enosh 为澳大利亚梦下了 10 年 60 万美元的赌注

summary.en: For this young migrant, getting ahead means thinking differently about wealth.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

Should you invest in shares, or property? Is university still worth it, or should you start your own business? With the path to financial security becoming less clear, Insight asks how aspirational people are getting ahead, and whether Australia is a good country to build wealth. Watch Insight episode Gettin' Rich at 8.30PM Tuesday 25 August on SBS or SBS On Demand.

Enosh Tampoe, 23, and his family migrated from Sri Lanka 16 years ago and have been living in the same rental property since then.

The Sydney mortgage and finance adviser says that as an immigrant family "starting from scratch", he felt financially behind his friends at times growing up.

"There were situations where I did feel like [I was] potentially behind — just because at the end of the day, there is that intergenerational wealth ...You'll notice obviously, they have their own houses; they have nice cars ..." he told Insight.

"Having that support from parents — whether it's in the form of getting money or continuing to live at home rent-free and all that stuff — definitely helps."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Feeling he couldn't rely on the "whole natural pathway of doing well in school, getting through uni and [getting] a big boy job" to build wealth, he took a hard approach to saving at an early age and bought a Sydney apartment two years ago.

Now, he's giving himself 10 years to save a $600,000 deposit for a $3 million Sydney home where his whole family can live.

"My end goal is … that great Australian dream: owning my own home, building my family and raising them in a nice neighbourhood," he said.

To reach his goal faster, he lives with his parents and rents out his apartment — taking advantage of the tax benefits of negative gearing to build equity.

Negative gearing refers to a situation where the ongoing costs of an investment exceed the rental income received, and the overall loss can then be claimed as a tax deduction.

But as of 1 July 2027, the federal government will restrict the tax benefits of negative gearing to new residential builds.

Enosh says this new law has reduced his borrowing capacity by "around 20 per cent", putting his plans to buy a second investment property this year on hold.

"If I were to purchase a second investment property, I'm not getting that benefit towards my salary or wage, that tax benefit."

Leticia Coco also became a homeowner in her early 20s — when her mother died from cancer, and she and her brother inherited the family home.

title.en: The hidden underbelly of Australia's weight-loss drug boom
title.zh: 澳大利亚减肥药热潮背后隐藏的弱点

summary.en: Below the surface of Australia's weight-loss drug boom, a market operates outside the prescription system.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
For Kansasin Darwan, living in Bajool in central Queensland, the weight-loss injection was supposed to be a solution. Instead, she says, it left her barely able to function.

The 48-year-old says she had gained weight during perimenopause and believed her Australian GP was unlikely to prescribe a weight-management medicine because she did not meet the relevant clinical criteria.

In Australia, GLP-1 weight loss drugs are generally prescribed for chronic weight management in adults with a body mass index (BMI) of 30 or higher, or a BMI of 27 to under 30 with at least one weight-related health condition.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

So, while on holiday in her home country of Thailand, Darwan went to a beauty clinic in outer Bangkok and bought an injectable medicine branded as Mounjaro.

Beauty clinics in Thailand are generally supervised by doctors. However, the screening process for GLP-1 use can be less extensive than the assessment typically conducted by GPs in Australia. For example, some customers at beauty clinics may be prescribed GLP-1 drugs even if they do not have diabetes or are within a healthy weight range.

"I couldn't concentrate while driving. I wasn't feeling like myself. I couldn't sleep. Even my children noticed that I was different," she tells SBS Thai.

Eighteen out of every 1,000 Australians, or almost 2 per cent of the population, are now taking GLP-1s regularly, according to a study by scientists at the University of New South Wales (UNSW) published in November 2025.

Darwan's experience offers a glimpse into a fast-growing market for weight-loss injections, where some Australians are seeking access overseas, while others are obtaining medicines through social-media sellers and informal supply channels.

An investigation by SBS Thai found weight-loss medicines being offered without a doctor's prescription in Australian community groups, reports of products entering the country through informal channels, and unapproved peptides being marketed as weight-loss products.

But access to these medicines is not uniformly occurring outside the established medical system. Many Australians obtain weight-loss drugs through registered health professionals and pharmacies.

For consumers navigating this market, the distinction between an approved prescription medicine, an experimental drug and an unapproved product can be difficult to see — with experts and authorities warning that using medicines outside approved pathways can carry serious risks.

title.en: One Nation MP admits the party's true migration target 'isn't too different' from Labor's
title.zh: 一国党议员承认该党真正的移民目标与工党的“没有太大不同”

summary.en: Pauline Hanson has had to intervene after one MP's revised intake figure raised key questions.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
One Nation's immigration stance is under question after an MP said the party would include an extra 100,000 people annually in its policy — bringing its target total higher than present forecasts under Labor.

Farrer MP David Farley, who clinched Sussan Ley's old seat from the coalition at a by-election, told the ABC Insiders program on Sunday morning that his party had decided to separate a "true NOM", or net overseas migration figure, from certain other categories of migrants.

However, party leader Pauline Hanson was forced to quickly intervene, refuting the claims just hours later on social media. Party policy is to "cut net overseas migration to 130,000".

This contradicts messaging from Farley, who said One Nation's stated policy of getting net overseas migration down to 130,000 excluded people brought in under a Pacific scheme, aged-care nurses and other in-demand skilled workers.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Adding those groups would amount to an additional 100,000 arrivals, bringing the total to 230,000 — 5,000 more than the budget forecast of 225,000 in the coming four years.

"What we're doing is we're focusing on the NOM in its true form, and then we've got these programs that have been available now for over a decade that drive our economy," Farley told Insiders.

"The raw number is not too different, but the reality is, where do we need them?

"We don't need them in the great urban metroplex — we need them out to be productive, working in agriculture, engineering, mining."

The comments come as public debate continues around the optimum level of migration to Australia.

Net overseas migration dropped to 306,000 in 2024-25, brought down from a post-pandemic peak of 538,000 under Liberal-National government policy.

Cabinet minister Chris Bowen said net overseas migration could not just be redefined.

"My overwhelming conclusion was he's pretty comfortable with what the government's doing," Bowen told reporters.

"I'm not sure what campaign One Nation's going to run on migration if they're effectively backing in what the Albanese government is doing."

Opposition immigration spokesman Jonno Duniam said voters were owed a clear explanation of what the party's immigration policy actually is.

"These are not semantic distinctions. They have real consequences for housing, infrastructure, essential services, wages, jobs and the economy," he said.

"For a party that has spent years telling Australians it has all the answers on immigration, One Nation is having extraordinary difficulty answering the most basic question of all: how many migrants would actually come to Australia under its policy."

title.en: Hong Kong hits back at ‘external forces’ after NGOs, foreign govt’s condemn conviction of Tiananmen vigil activists
title.zh: 在非政府组织和外国政府谴责天安门守夜活动人士被定罪后，香港反击“外部势力”

summary.en: The Hong Kong government and the legislature have hit back at “external forces” that voiced concerns over the conviction of two pro-democracy figures who organised Hong Kong’s annual Tiananmen vigils. In a statement, the government “expressed strong dissatisfaction with and firm...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The Hong Kong government and the legislature have hit back at “external forces” that voiced concerns over the conviction of two pro-democracy figures who organised Hong Kong’s annual Tiananmen vigils. Hong Kong police set up a cordon outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on August 21, 2026, ahead of the verdict hearing of the trial of two Tiananmen vigil activists Chow Hang-tang and Lee Cheuk-yan on national security charges. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In a statement, the government “expressed strong dissatisfaction with and firm opposition to, and strongly condemned, the baseless slanders” by western nations as well as “anti-China media, organisations and politicians.” Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of inciting subversion on Friday, along with their now-defunct Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China. The Saturday statement was issued in response to governments, activists, and overseas human rights groups who expressed concern about what they saw as declining freedoms in the city. The condemnation came after Chow and Lee were accused of inciting others to topple the ruling Chinese Communist Party (CCP) through the Alliance’s calls to “end one-party rule” in China, a key tenet of the group since its founding in 1989. From left: Lee Cheuk-yan, Albert Ho, Chow Hang-tung. Photos: HKFP. Former lawmaker Albert Ho, another leader of the group who was charged alongside the pair convicted on Friday, pleaded guilty when the trial began in January. Earlier, prosecutors argued that the Alliance’s calls breached China’s constitution, after a 2018 amendment stipulated that the CCP’s leadership is the “defining feature” of the country’s “fundamental” socialist system. The Tiananmen vigil in Victoria Park on June 4, 2019. File photo: Holmes Chan/HKFP. Echoing Friday’s judgment, the government statement said that the defendants “refused to pull back from the brink” even after Beijing implemented a national security law in Hong Kong, “and were bent on embracing the resistance line of the Alliance to the very end.” ‘Patriots only’ The Legislative Council secretariat on Saturday issued a similarly worded statement, condemning “smearing and slanderous remarks by external forces” over the court verdict. In March 2021, Beijing restricted elections to ensure only “patriots” govern Hong Kong. The move attracted criticism as it reduced democratic representation and introduced candidate vetting, whilst authorities say the revamp ensured stability and prosperity. “Under the executive-led system,” the statement read, the legislature will “certainly continue to fully support the [Hong Kong] government in administering in accordance with the law and firmly safeguarding national security,...
body.zh: 香港政府和立法机关对“外部势力”进行了反击，这些势力对组织香港年度天安门守夜活动的两名亲民主人士被定罪表示担忧。 2026 年 8 月 21 日，在两名天安门守夜活动人士周行棠和李卓人因国家安全罪名受审的判决听证会之前，香港警方在西九龙法院大楼外设置了警戒线。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。中国政府在一份声明中“对西方国家以及反华媒体、组织和政客的无端诽谤表示强烈不满、坚决反对和强烈谴责”。周五，周恒东和李卓人以及他们现已解散的香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。周六的声明是为了回应各国政府、活动人士和海外人权组织，他们对香港自由度下降表示担忧。周和李被指控通过联盟呼吁在中国“结束一党统治”煽动他人推翻执政的中国共产党（CCP），这是该组织自 1989 年成立以来的一个关键宗旨。左起：李卓人、何俊仁、周恒东。照片：HKFP。前立法会议员何俊仁（Albert Ho）是该组织的另一位领导人，与周五被定罪的两人一起受到指控，他在一月份审判开始时认罪。此前，检察官辩称，该联盟的呼吁违反了中国宪法，因为2018年的宪法修正案规定，中国共产党的领导是中国“基本”社会主义制度的“决定性特征”。 2019 年 6 月 4 日在维多利亚公园举行的天安门守夜活动。资料照片：Holmes Chan/HKFP。政府声明呼应周五的判决，称即使北京在香港实施国家安全法，被告也“拒绝从悬崖边退缩”，“并一心坚持到底联盟的抵抗路线”。 “只有爱国者” 立法会秘书处周六发表了一份措辞类似的声明，谴责“外部势力对法院判决的抹黑和诽谤言论”。 2021年3月，北京限制选举，以确保只有“爱国者”治理香港。此举引起了批评，因为它减少了民主代表性并引入了候选人审查，而当局表示，改革确保了稳定和繁荣。声明称，“在行政主导体制下，立法机关一定会继续全力支持（香港）政府依法施政，坚决维护国家安全……

title.en: Elderly couple dead in suspected murder-suicide

summary.en: Police have launched a murder-suicide investigation following the deaths of an elderly couple in a public housing estate in Kwai Chung, in what authorities are describing as a family tragedy. Officers were called to Chun Kwai House at around 11.32pm on Sunday after a security...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Police have launched a murder-suicide investigation following the deaths of an elderly couple in a public housing estate in Kwai Chung, in what authorities are describing as a family tragedy. Officers were called to Chun Kwai House at around 11.32pm on Sunday after a security guard reported finding an 80-year-old man lying on the ground, apparently having fallen from a height. He was pronounced dead at the scene. Upon entering the family’s upper-floor flat, police discovered the body of the man’s 66-year-old wife in the living room. She had sustained severe head injuries from blunt-force trauma, which investigators believe were caused by a hard object and are being treated as the primary cause of death. During a search of the unit, officers found that all windows and window grilles were open. No suicide note was found, but three mobile phones belonging to the couple were recovered. "In a public rubbish bin in the lift lobby on the same floor, officers discovered two bags of bloodstained clothing and some bloodstained hard objects, such as a 60-centimetre heavy-duty metal frame, two metal rods, and a clothes drying rack, which are believed to be linked to the above case," said Wan Chun-hong, acting assistant district commander (crime) of the Kwai Tsing District. According to preliminary investigations, the couple had been married for more than 40 years. The husband was a retiree, while the wife worked as a cleaner. Although there were no prior reports of domestic disputes, or any known psychiatric history, family members recently revealed that the couple had been considering divorce due to ongoing relationship issues. The deceased husband had also reportedly expressed suicidal thoughts. Police will arrange for autopsies on both deceased to clarify the cause of death. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 一对老年夫妇在葵涌公共屋村死亡，当局称这是一场家庭悲剧，警方已展开谋杀-自杀调查。周日晚上 11 时 32 分左右，一名保安报告称，发现一名 80 岁男子躺在地上，显然是从高处坠落，警方随后被叫到俊贵楼。他被宣布当场死亡。警方进入该家庭的楼上公寓后，在客厅里发现了该男子 66 岁妻子的尸体。她因钝器外伤而头部严重受伤，调查人员认为这是由硬物造成的，并被视为死​​亡的主要原因。在搜查该单位时，警方发现所有窗户和窗花都开着。没有发现遗书，但发现了这对夫妇的三部手机。葵青警区代理助理指挥官（刑事）尹俊康表示，警方在同层电梯大堂的公共垃圾桶内发现两袋沾有血迹的衣物，以及一些沾有血迹的硬物，例如一个60公分的重型金属架、两根金属棒和一个晾衣架，相信与上述案件有关。据初步调查，这对夫妇结婚已有40多年。丈夫是退休人员，妻子是清洁工。尽管之前没有关于家庭纠纷的报道，也没有任何已知的精神病史，但家庭成员最近透露，由于持续的关系问题，这对夫妇一直在考虑离婚。据报道，已故丈夫也曾表达过自杀念头。警方将安排对两名死者进行尸检，以查明死因。托尼·萨宾编辑

body.en: The Observatory on Monday said the chance of issuing a tropical cyclone warning signal is relatively low unless Narra edges closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River estuary. The storm is expected to linger in the vicinity of Beibu Wan on Monday, and turn northeastwards gradually on Tuesday, edging closer to the western coast of Leizhou peninsula in the next couple of days. The weather forecaster says Narra is expected to maintain quite some distance from Hong Kong. Apart from Narra, the Observatory said the direct threat from another tropical cyclone Gaenari to Hong Kong is not high, as it is expected to dissipate gradually in the vicinity of Taiwan Strait on Monday. Edited by Tony Sabine

title.en: Sushi Express begins investigation after customer finds suspected worm in salmon sushi
title.zh: 顾客在三文鱼寿司中发现疑似蠕虫后，Sushi Express 开始调查

summary.en: A sushi takeout chain has initiated an investigation after a customer found a suspected worm in a box of salmon sushi sold at a branch in Tsuen Wan. Sushi Express Hong Kong said in a Facebook post on Sunday that it had sent a sample for third-party testing, and that it would...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A sushi takeout chain has initiated an investigation after a customer found a suspected worm in a box of salmon sushi sold at a branch in Tsuen Wan. A photo taken by a Threads user showing a suspected worm in a box of sushi from Sushi Express. Photo: johnsonyip24, via Threads. Sushi Express Hong Kong said in a Facebook post on Sunday that it had sent a sample for third-party testing, and that it would publicise the results when they are available. “Food safety is our most important principle. We will follow up, and we thank everyone for their attention and feedback,” the post, written in Chinese, read. On Friday, a user on social media platform Threads posted a photo of a box of salmon sushi with what appeared to be a worm. He said he was at Sushi Express in Nina Mall, a shopping centre in Tsuen Wan, when he noticed something moving in the box. “Told staff, and they insisted it was not [a worm]. I said clearly that it was moving! [They] still said it wasn’t,” his Threads post, in Chinese, read. He said he placed the sushi back and left. HKFP has reached out to the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department for comment. Past controversies It is not the first time Sushi Express has been embroiled in food safety controversies. Last July, media reported that local branches of the Taiwanese chain left cooked rice outside the refrigerator for over 16 hours without temperature control. Nina Mall 2 in Tsuen Wan. Photo: GovHK. In response to enquiries, Sushi Express defended itself without denying the accusations, saying that it uses insulated boxes to transport its rice and a tamper-proof system to ensure the boxes do not get opened during transportation. Last May, a customer at a Yuen Long branch bought tamagoyaki – an egg omelette roll – that was believed to have grown mould. Sushi Express said it “regretted the inconvenience” caused by the incident. In a social media post, the chain said it suspended the sales of tamagoyaki from that branch for the day, and that those with concerns may ask for a refund. It also added that staff had deep cleaned the store and also inspected hygiene conditions at other branches.
body.zh: 一名顾客在荃湾一间分店出售的三文鱼寿司盒内发现疑似蠕虫，一家寿司外卖连锁店已展开调查。 Threads 用户拍摄的照片显示 Sushi Express 的寿司盒中存在疑似蠕虫。照片：johnsonyip24，来自 Threads。 Sushi Express Hong Kong周日在Facebook上发帖称，已发送样品进行第三方测试，一旦有结果，将公布结果。 “食品安全是我们最重要的原则，我们会跟进，感谢大家的关注和反馈，”这篇中文帖子写道。周五，社交媒体平台 Threads 上的一名用户发布了一张三文鱼寿司盒的照片，上面似乎有一条蠕虫。他说，当时他正在荃湾如心广场购物中心的寿司店，发现盒子里有东西在动。 “告诉工作人员，他们坚称这不是[蠕虫]。我明确表示它在移动！[他们]仍然说它没有，”他的中文帖子写道。他说他把寿司放回去然后离开了。 HKFP已联系食物环境卫生署征求意见。过去的争议 Sushi Express 并非第一次卷入食品安全争议。去年7月，媒体报道称，这家台湾连锁店的当地分店将煮熟的米饭放在冰箱外超过16个小时，而且没有温度控制。荃湾如心广场2期。照片：香港政府一站通。 Sushi Express在回应询问时为自己辩护，但没有否认这些指控，称其使用隔热箱来运输大米，并采用防篡改系统来确保箱子在运输过程中不会被打开。去年五月，元朗一家分店的一名顾客购买了玉子烧（一种鸡蛋煎蛋卷），据信该玉子烧已经发霉。 Sushi Express 表示，对此次事件造成的不便表示“遗憾”。该连锁店在社交媒体上发帖称，该分店当天暂停了玉子烧的销售，有疑虑的顾客可以要求退款。它还补充说，工作人员已对商店进行了深度清洁，并检查了其他分店的卫生状况。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: Hong Kong to enforce smart safety systems on sites
title.zh: 香港将在工地实施智能安全系统

summary.en: Authorities unveiled a sweeping new drive to fortify construction site safety, pledging to mandate advanced protective systems across all public works as part of a zero-tolerance push against workplace accidents. Speaking at the kick-off ceremony of the annual Construction...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Authorities unveiled a sweeping new drive to fortify construction site safety, pledging to mandate advanced protective systems across all public works as part of a zero-tolerance push against workplace accidents. Speaking at the kick-off ceremony of the annual Construction Safety Week on Monday, Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said the industry had already seen measurable progress, with overall accident rates dropping by roughly 20 percent between 2023 and 2025. That decline, she said, has been largely attributed to the growing adoption of the city's Smart Site Safety System (4S), which is now installed at about 80 percent of local construction sites. Of these, 60 percent have earned the official 4S label. Yet Linn stressed that the current momentum is not enough. "When it comes to construction safety, even one accident is one too many. Our goal is to make 4S the standard configuration for all construction sites in Hong Kong — a baseline provision — providing frontline workers with a safer working environment," she said. To keep pace with evolving industry risks, the Development Bureau updated its technical guidelines last month, adding three new categories of 4S devices to better cover high-risk processes across public works projects. Anchored by this year's theme "Build Smart. Care with Heart. Own the Task", the safety push extends well beyond hardware. The development chief emphasised that lasting safety rests on three integrated pillars — smart technology, a compassionate culture of mutual care among workers, and firm accountability at every level. "Every frontline worker is a valuable resource for our industry," she said, calling for companies to invest more in worker welfare, mentorship for newcomers, and family-centred safety campaigns. Offering a front-line perspective, Construction Industry Council (CIC) chairman Thomas Ho acknowledged the progress made but noted that the industry had already recorded 15 fatal accidents this year — matching the total for the whole of last year. He pointed to the persistent "rush" culture on sites as an area requiring continued attention, urging project stakeholders to pause and assess risks before proceeding with high-risk tasks. "All 15 cases were like this. This is the number one killer ... Among these 15 cases, many were not urgent. But for some reason, from the top all the way down to the foreman, it's always 'hurry up, hurry up'," he said. While the adoption of the 4S has expanded significantly, Ho observed that safety practices have not always been fully embedded at the operational level. He cited a survey by the CIC showing that 14 percent of frontline workers and six percent of foremen do not routinely conduct dynamic risk assessments — an area where further training and management...
body.zh: 当局推出了一项全面的新举措，以加强建筑工地安全，承诺在所有公共工程中强制采用先进的保护系统，作为对工作场所事故零容忍的一部分。周一，发展局局长贝尔纳黛特·林恩 (Bernadette Linn) 在一年一度的建筑安全周启动仪式上发表讲话时表示，该行业已经取得了显着进展，2023 年至 2025 年间，总体事故率下降了约 20%。她表示，这一下降很大程度上归因于越来越多地采用该市的智能工地安全系统 (4S)，该系统目前已在当地约 80% 的建筑工地安装。其中，60%已获得官方4S标签。但林恩强调，目前的势头还不够。她说：“在建筑安全方面，即使发生一起事故，也是一次事故。我们的目标是让4S成为全港建筑地盘的标准配置，作为一项底线规定，为前线工人提供更安全的工作环境。”为应对不断变化的行业风险，发展局上月更新了技术指引，新增三类4S设备，以更好地涵盖工务项目的高风险流程。以今年的主题“智能构建。用心关怀。承担任务”为主题，安全推动远远超出了硬件范围。这位发展负责人强调，持久的安全取决于三个综合支柱——智能技术、工人之间相互关怀的富有同情心的文化以及各级的坚定问责制。她说：“每一位一线工人都是我们行业的宝贵资源。”她呼吁企业在工人福利、新员工指导以及以家庭为中心的安全活动方面加大投入。建造业议会（CIC）主席何厚诚从前线角度对所取得的进展表示认可，但指出该行业今年已发生 15 起致命事故，与去年全年的总数持平。他指出工地持续存在的“匆忙”文化是一个需要持续关注的领域，敦促项目利益相关者在继续执行高风险任务之前暂停并评估风险。 “这15起案件都是这样，这是头号杀手……在这15起案件中，很多案件并不紧急。但出于某种原因，从高层一直到领班，总是‘快点，快点’，”他说。虽然 4S 的采用已显着扩大，但 Ho 指出，安全实践并不总是完全融入到操作层面。他引用了 CIC 的一项调查，显示 14% 的一线工人和 6% 的工头不会定期进行动态风险评估——这是一个需要进一步培训和管理的领域……

title.en: HK 'ideal launchpad for mainland firms going global'
title.zh: 香港是“内地企业走向世界的理想跳板”

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee on Monday said Hong Kong is the ideal springboard for mainland unicorn companies and technological startups seeking to expand internationally. Speaking at the opening of the Global Unicorn Summit at the Convention & Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, he...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee on Monday said Hong Kong is the ideal springboard for mainland unicorn companies and technological startups seeking to expand internationally. Speaking at the opening of the Global Unicorn Summit at the Convention & Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, he pointed out that the city has nurtured around 20 local unicorn companies over the past decade, showing its ability to foster world-class innovative enterprises. He said Hong Kong provides all-round support for startups. “The two flagship technology hubs in Hong Kong – Hong Kong Science Park and Cyberport – provide start-ups at various stages of development with comprehensive support: including incubation programmes, matching funds, marketing, expansion opportunities, as well as infrastructure,” Lee said. Hong Kong is also the premier hub for top overseas tech and innovation enterprises to expand into the mainland market, he added. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 行政长官李家超周一表示，香港是内地独角兽公司和寻求国际扩张的科技初创公司的理想跳板。他在湾仔会议展览中心举行的全球独角兽峰会开幕式上致辞时指出，过去十年，香港培育了约20家本地独角兽企业，展现了培育世界级创新企业的能力。他表示，香港为初创企业提供全方位支持。李说：“香港的两个旗舰科技中心——香港科学园和数码港——为处于不同发展阶段的初创企业提供全面的支持，包括孵化计划、配套资金、营销、扩张机会以及基础设施。”他补充说，香港也是海外顶尖科技创新企业拓展内地市场的首选枢纽。托尼·萨宾编辑

title.en: In Hong Kong, mourning a stray dog killed in mainland China means walking a fine line
title.zh: 在香港，哀悼一只在中国大陆被杀的流浪狗意味着要小心行事

summary.en: Outside a commercial building in Causeway Bay, one of Hong Kong’s busiest shopping districts, a column of people carrying umbrellas and flowers wrapped around the block. For hours, mourners waited in the rain so they could pay their respects to Wang Wang, a stray dog who was...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Outside a commercial building in Causeway Bay, one of Hong Kong’s busiest shopping districts, a column of people carrying umbrellas and flowers wrapped around the block. For hours, mourners waited in the rain so they could pay their respects to Wang Wang, a stray dog who was killed by five boys in mainland China. People wait in line to lay down flowers for Wang Wang, on July 25, 2026. Photo: James Lee/HKFP. Holding a bouquet of white chrysanthemums, Brian patiently waited his turn to cram into a lift that would bring him to a small Buddhist temple on the 23rd floor. The 26-year-old from Guangzhou crossed the boundary into Hong Kong earlier that day to take part in the procession, which he had heard about from social media. Wang Wang and her three puppies were tortured and killed on June 28 in a village in Jieyang, Guangdong province, by five boys all under 14 years old. Videos of the incident, which have since been scrubbed from Chinese social media platforms, show the boys beating the dogs with sticks and dousing Wang Wang in fuel before setting her on fire. Footage of the horrific killings spread throughout the internet, ending up on social media feeds in Hong Kong and beyond. As billboards funded by ordinary Chinese people went up in New York’s Times Square and around the Taipei 101 skyscraper, Hongkongers have also tried to advocate for animal rights in mainland China. “When I first saw the video I was furious, and now I just feel helpless. I just hope I can send off Wang Wang and her puppies one last time,” said Brian, who used a pseudonym for fear of reprisals. Brian, from Guangzhou, brought chrysanthemums to pay his respects to Wang Wang, on July 25, 2026. Photo: James Lee/HKFP. 💡 HKFP grants anonymity to known sources under tightly controlled, limited circumstances defined in our Ethics Code . Among the reasons senior editors may approve the use of anonymity for sources are threats to safety, job security or fears of reprisals. What he didn’t know was that the funeral had been pushed online less than 24 hours before it was originally scheduled to take place. Now, mourners would only be allowed to lay down flowers outside the venue. The funeral’s organiser, the Hong Kong Animal Rights Association, also pulled out of an interview with HKFP on the morning of the ceremony. Brian was also unaware that the entrance of the building would be flanked by half a dozen plainclothes police officers. Not far from the temple, a Thai boxing gym had also been asked to take down a banner of Wang Wang after the building’s management office was visited by police. At the same time, charities and activists have struggled to get advertisements depicting the dogs approved by public transport companies. In the years since Hong Kong saw mass protests in 2019...
body.zh: 香港最繁忙的购物区之一铜锣湾的一栋商业大楼外，一队人拿着雨伞和鲜花围住了整个街区。哀悼者在雨中等待了几个小时，以便向在中国大陆被五个男孩杀害的流浪狗旺旺表示敬意。 2026 年 7 月 25 日，人们排队等候为旺旺献花。照片：James Lee/HKFP。布莱恩手捧一束白菊花，耐心等待轮到他挤进电梯，乘电梯前往 23 楼的一座小佛寺。这位来自广州的 26 岁男子当天早些时候越境进入香港参加游行，他是从社交媒体上听说的。 6月28日，旺旺和她的三只小狗在广东省揭阳市的一个村庄被五名14岁以下的男孩折磨致死。该事件的视频已从中国社交媒体平台上删除，视频显示男孩们用棍棒殴打狗，并在旺旺身上浇上燃料，然后将其点燃。可怕杀戮的视频在互联网上传播，最终出现在香港及其他地区的社交媒体上。随着普通中国人资助的广告牌在纽约时代广场和台北101摩天大楼周围竖起，香港人也试图在中国大陆倡导动物权利。 “当我第一次看到这段视频时，我非常愤怒，现在我只感到无助。我只希望能最后一次送走旺旺和她的小狗，”布莱恩说。由于担心遭到报复，他使用了化名。 2026 年 7 月 25 日，来自广州的布莱恩带着菊花向王旺表示敬意。照片：James Lee/HKFP。 💡 HKFP 在我们的道德准则中规定的严格控制、有限的情况下对已知消息来源给予匿名。高级编辑可能批准对消息来源使用匿名的原因包括对安全、工作保障的威胁或担心遭到报复。他不知道的是，葬礼在原定举行日期前不到24小时就被推送到了网上。现在，哀悼者只能在会场外献花。葬礼的组织者香港动物权利协会也在仪式当天早上退出了香港新闻社的采访。布莱恩也不知道大楼入口两侧会有六名便衣警察。距离寺庙不远的一家泰拳馆在警方拜访管理处后，也被要求取下“旺旺”的横幅。与此同时，慈善机构和活动人士一直在努力让描绘狗的广告获得公共交通公司的批准。自2019年香港发生大规模抗议以来的这些年里……

title.en: Chinese comedian Guo Degang investigated after patriotic song gag
title.zh: 中国喜剧演员郭德纲因爱国歌曲笑话被调查

summary.en: A famous Chinese comedian is under investigation, local authorities told AFP on Sunday, after he reportedly poked fun at a patriotic song during a performance. The ruling Communist Party maintains tight control over China’s arts scene, and the government has enacted laws in...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A famous Chinese comedian is under investigation, local authorities told AFP on Sunday, after he reportedly poked fun at a patriotic song during a performance. Chinese comedian Guo Degang. Photo: Kai Tak Sports Park. The ruling Communist Party maintains tight control over China’s arts scene, and the government has enacted laws in recent years to protect national heroes and symbols from purported slander. Guo Degang, 53, allegedly improvised part of a 1956 tune about Chinese fighters defeating Japanese soldiers in World War II during a performance in the central city of Wuhan in July, according to local media reports. The Wuhan culture and tourism bureau confirmed by phone to AFP on Sunday that an investigation into Guo was ongoing, but it was not clear what stage it had reached. Guo, from the northern city of Tianjin, is known for reviving a style of rapid comic dialogue called crosstalk — “xiangsheng” in Chinese — during the 2000s and 2010s. He has performed on state broadcaster CCTV’s annual Spring Festival Gala and at the Great Hall of the People, a grand government building in Beijing that hosts major state events. Guo was unable to be reached on social media, and his Weibo account seems to have been inactive since August 9. The Great Hall of People in China. Photo: Mirko Kuzmanovic, via Shutterstock. Venues in other Chinese cities have postponed perfomances featuring Guo this month and have been offering refunds. The song, “Playing My Beloved Pipa”, was recognised in 2019 as an “outstanding” song celebrating the founding of The People’s Republic of China, online outlet The Paper reported this month. In one instance, Guo allegedly changed the lyric, “quiet on Weishan Lake”, to “quiet in the Forbidden City” — China’s former seat of imperial power — and performed the lines with a “comedic” touch, the report said. Authorities had not approved his riff before the performance, The Paper said, citing Wuhan’s culture bureau. It reported that local authorities were investigating Guo for “suspected violations” of rules on commercial performances. Under President Xi Jinping, authorities have tightened their oversight of arts performances, including comedy shows. In 2023, authorities fined a performing group the equivalent of millions of dollars and suspended their shows indefinitely after a comic made an oblique joke about the armed forces. Li Haoshi referenced a well-known army slogan while joking about watching his dogs chase a squirrel — which officials said had “caused a bad social impact” and broken the law.
body.zh: 地方当局周日告诉法新社，一名中国著名喜剧演员正在接受调查，据报道他在表演中取笑一首爱国歌曲。中国喜剧演员郭德纲。照片：启德体育公园。执政的共产党对中国的艺术界保持着严格的控制，政府近年来颁布了法律来保护民族英雄和象征免受所谓的诽谤。据当地媒体报道，53 岁的郭德纲据称在 7 月在中部城市武汉的一场演出中即兴创作了一首 1956 年的歌曲，该歌曲讲述的是二战中中国战士击败日本士兵的故事。武汉文化和旅游局周日通过电话向法新社证实，对郭的调查正在进行中，但尚不清楚调查进展到什么阶段。郭来自北方城市天津，因复兴 2000 年代和 2010 年代一种名为相声的快速相声风格而闻名。他曾在中央电视台一年一度的春节联欢晚会上以及在人民大会堂（北京一座举办重大国家活动的宏伟政府大楼）进行表演。无法在社交媒体上联系到郭，他的微博账户似乎自 8 月 9 日以来一直处于闲置状态。 中国人民大会堂。照片：Mirko Kuzmanovic，来自 Shutterstock。中国其他城市的场馆已推迟本月郭的演出并提供退款。据澎湃新闻本月报道，这首歌曲《弹奏我心爱的琵琶》被评为2019年庆祝中华人民共和国成立“优秀”歌曲。报道称，有一次，郭据称将歌词“微山湖静”改为“紫禁城静”——中国以前的皇权所在地——并以一种“喜剧”的方式表演台词。澎湃新闻援引武汉市文化局的消息称，当局在演出前并未批准他的即兴表演。据报道，地方当局正在调查郭“涉嫌违反”商业演出规则。在习近平主席的领导下，当局加强了对包括喜剧表演在内的艺术表演的监管。 2023 年，一名喜剧演员对武装部队开了一个拐弯抹角的玩笑，当局对一个表演团体处以数百万美元的罚款，并无限期暂停他们的演出。李浩石一边开玩笑说自己看着自己的狗追松鼠，一边引用了一句著名的军队口号——官员们表示，这“造成了恶劣的社会影响”，而且触犯了法律。

title.en: China mulls bid to host 2028 UN climate talks: sources
title.zh: 中国考虑申办2028年联合国气候谈判：消息人士

summary.en: China is mulling a bid to host UN climate talks in 2028, two sources familiar with the matter told AFP Friday, as it seeks to burnish its reputation as a leader in the fight against global warming. Beijing has not yet made a final decision regarding the proposal for the COP33...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: China is mulling a bid to host UN climate talks in 2028, two sources familiar with the matter told AFP Friday, as it seeks to burnish its reputation as a leader in the fight against global warming. The United Nations in Geneva, Switzerland. Photo: Wikicommons. Beijing has not yet made a final decision regarding the proposal for the COP33 summit, both sources said, nor is there a clear timeline for doing so. The host does not have to be decided this year. China’s interest was first reported by Bloomberg News. The UN’s annual climate gatherings rotate among regional blocs. This year’s COP31 is scheduled to take place in Turkey, followed by COP32 in Ethiopia in 2027. The 2028 summit falls to the Asia-Pacific. In April, India withdrew its offer to host COP33 without specifying a reason. South Korea has previously expressed interest. The Chinese embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a query for comment. The UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) secretariat told AFP: “We have not been informed by the Asia-Pacific Regional Group on the nomination of the host country for COP33. “Regional groups hold consultations first to determine which country from their respective regions will offer to host on behalf of the group. Once agreed, the chair of that regional group formally sends an official nomination to the secretariat.” China has in recent years positioned itself as a counterweight to the United States. The White House. Photo: White House, via Flickr. Under President Donald Trump, the US left the landmark Paris climate agreement twice while the administration seeks to boost fossil fuels. Hosting UN climate talks could thus be an opportunity for China to boost its credentials as a climate leader. The world’s second-largest economy also has an economic interest as the leading exporter of green technologies, including solar panels, electric vehicles, wind turbines and batteries. US-China dynamics But hosting the gathering could also cast an unwelcome spotlight on China, which, with its population of 1.4 billion and massive manufacturing industry, is the world’s biggest greenhouse emitter, followed by the United States, India and the European Union. Although it has pledged to achieve carbon neutrality before 2060, it is targeting only a modest 7-10 percent reduction in economy-wide greenhouse gas emissions by 2035, compared to peak levels. Another piece that China is considering is the US-China dynamic, one source said. Climate cooperation had been a key feature of the bilateral relationship under former presidents Joe Biden and Barack Obama, and COP33 could spur renewed collaboration if a Democrat is elected in 2028. The summit would likely fall days after the US presidential election...
body.zh: 两名知情人士周五告诉法新社，中国正在考虑申办 2028 年联合国气候谈判，以提升其作为应对全球变暖领导者的声誉。联合国位于瑞士日内瓦。照片：维基共享资源。两位消息人士称，北京尚未就 COP33 峰会的提议做出最终决定，也没有明确的时间表。今年不必决定主办方。彭博新闻社最先报道了中国的兴趣。联合国年度气候会议在区域集团之间轮流举行。今年的 COP31 定于土耳其举行，COP32 将于 2027 年在埃塞俄比亚举行。2028 年峰会将在亚太地区举行。 4月份，印度撤回了主办COP33的提议，但没有具体说明原因。韩国此前已表达了兴趣。中国驻华盛顿大使馆没有立即回应置评请求。联合国气候变化框架公约（UNFCCC）秘书处告诉法新社：“我们尚未收到亚太区域集团关于COP33主办国提名的通知。区域集团首先进行磋商，以确定各自地区的哪个国家将代表该集团主办。”一旦达成一致，该区域小组主席将正式向秘书处发送正式提名。”近年来，中国将自己定位为制衡美国的力量。白宫。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。在唐纳德·特朗普总统的领导下，美国两次退出具有里程碑意义的巴黎气候协议，而政府则寻求增加化石燃料。因此，主办联合国气候谈判可能成为中国提升其气候领导者地位的机会。作为世界第二大经济体，作为太阳能电池板、电动汽车、风力涡轮机和电池等绿色技术的主要出口国，也拥有经济利益。美中动态 但主办这次聚会也可能会让人们不受欢迎地把注意力集中在中国身上。中国拥有 14 亿人口和庞大的制造业，是世界上最大的温室气体排放国，其次是美国、印度和欧盟。尽管它承诺在 2060 年之前实现碳中和，但其目标只是到 2035 年将整个经济的温室气体排放量比峰值水平小幅减少 7-10%。一位消息人士称，中国正在考虑的另一件事是美中动态。气候合作一直是前总统乔·拜登和巴拉克·奥巴马领导下双边关系的一个关键特征，如果民主党在 2028 年当选，COP33 可能会激发新的合作。峰会可能会在美国总统大选几天后举行……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to stewardship, provision, and the common good. 1 Peter 4:10 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with stewardship that serves neighbours, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到管家责任、供应与公共福祉。1 Peter 4:10提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以服事邻舍的好管家心态来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists
title.zh: “她无所畏惧”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动家之一的狱中手稿

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung, a prominent Hong Kong democracy activist, has been detained since 2021. From prison, she continues to write on various topics, including the meaning of freedom and the Tiananmen Square events, despite being found guilty of “inciting subversion.”
summary.zh: 香港著名民主活动家邹幸彤自2021年起被拘留。尽管被判“煽动颠覆罪”，她仍在狱中笔耕不辍，撰写关于自由的意义和天安门事件等各种主题的文章。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unwavering spirit of activists like Chow Hang-tung, who continue to speak truth from confinement, reminds us of the biblical call to advocate for the vulnerable. Yahweh's word encourages us to be a voice for those who cannot speak for themselves, especially the destitute and those whose rights are denied. Her writings from prison embody a profound...
reflection.zh: 邹幸彤等活动家在囚禁中仍坚定不移地发出真理之声，这提醒我们圣经呼召我们要为弱势群体发声。雅伟的话语鼓励我们为那些不能为自己说话的人，特别是贫困和权利被剥夺的人，开口辩护。她在狱中的文字体现了对正义和自由的深刻承诺，即使为此付出个人代价。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

summary.en: UK Foreign Office condemns use of national security law to convict activists Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung Two Hong Kong activists who organised annual vigils marking China’s deadly Tiananmen crackdown in 1989 have been found guilty of “incitement to subversion” in one of the...

body.en: UK Foreign Office condemns use of national security law to convict activists Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung Two Hong Kong activists who organised annual vigils marking China’s deadly Tiananmen crackdown in 1989 have been found guilty of “incitement to subversion” in one of the most high-profile cases in Hong Kong since Beijing imposed its national security law in 2020. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”, a press summary handed out to reporters said. The defendants each face a maximum penalty of 10 years in jail, with sentencing expected at a later date. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国外交部谴责利用国家安全法对活动人士李卓人和周恒东定罪 两名香港活动人士组织了年度守夜活动，纪念中国 1989 年致命的天安门镇压，他们被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”，这是自北京于 2020 年实施国家安全法以来香港最引人注目的案件之一。李卓人，69 岁和周恒东，41 岁，一份发给记者的新闻摘要称，“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。被告每人将面临最高 10 年监禁的刑罚，预计稍后宣判。继续阅读...

A week earlier the crop, located in Gangwon province, had looked fine. Now the potatoes came up soft and collapsing, “like boiled potatoes”, spoiled by heat that had turned the ground into something closer to an oven. Continue reading...
body.zh: 韩国农民正遭受创纪录的高温，香港报告了有史以来的最高气温，日本也经历了新指定的“酷热”日子。在首尔东北 80 英里（130 公里）的阳谷县的一片马铃薯田里，李相赫 (Lee Sang-hyuk) 挖了土，却发现没有任何值得挽救的东西。一周前，位于江原道的作物看起来状况良好。现在，土豆变软了，塌陷了，“就像煮土豆一样”，由于高温而变质，地面变成了接近烤箱的东西。继续阅读...

body.en: Authorities warn that days of intense rain could trigger widespread flooding and landslides as storm moves north and further inland More than a million people were moved to safety across eastern China by Sunday evening as powerful Typhoon Dolphin made landfall amid fears torrential rain would cause flooding and landslides. Wenzhou, a coastal city in Zhejiang province, said it relocated more than 900,000 people and opened more than 1,500 emergency shelters. In neighbouring Fujian, 98,900 people were moved from high-risk areas. Continue reading...
body.zh: 当局警告称，随着风暴向北并进一步向内陆移动，连日的强降雨可能引发大范围的洪水和山体滑坡。由于担心暴雨会引发洪水和山体滑坡，截至周日晚上，强大的台风“海豚”登陆中国东部，已有超过一百万人被转移到安全地带。浙江省沿海城市温州表示，已转移超过90万人，并开设了1500多个应急避难所。在邻近的福建省，9.89万人从高风险地区转移。继续阅读...

body.en:
Police are investigating the death of a woman who was struck by a car that crashed into a restaurant at Westfield Knox in Wantirna South in Melbourne’s east.

Emergency services responded to reports of the crash at about 12.45pm on Monday, according to Ambulance Victoria .

The female customer, who has not yet been formally identified, died at the scene. A second customer was treated by paramedics at the scene.

The driver and passenger were both taken to Maroondah hospital in stable conditions.

Police have launched an investigation but said they “do not believe the incident was an intentional act”.

In a social media post, cafe Martini & Co said it was “temporarily closed until further notice”.
body.zh: 警方正在调查一名妇女因汽车撞向墨尔本东部万提那南 Westfield Knox 的一家餐厅而死亡。 据维多利亚救护车中心称，紧急服务部门于周一中午 12 点 45 分左右对事故报告做出了回应。 这名女顾客的身份尚未正式确定，她当场死亡。第二名顾客在现场接受了护理人员的治疗。 司机和乘客均被送往 Maroondah 医院，目前情况稳定。 警方已展开调查，但表示“不认为这起事件是故意行为”。 Martini & Co 咖啡馆在社交媒体帖子中表示，“暂时关闭，直至另行通知”。

title.en: Wild beaver kits born in Norfolk for first time in more than 500 years
title.zh: 500多年来首次在诺福克诞生野生海狸幼仔

summary.en: Pair are offspring of two beavers who mysteriously arrived in Pensthorpe nature reserve near Fakenham in December Wild beaver kits have been born in Norfolk for the first time in more than 500 years. The pair of newborns are the offspring of two free-living beavers who...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Wild beaver kits have been born in Norfolk for the first time in more than 500 years.

The pair of newborns are the offspring of two free-living beavers who mysteriously arrived in Pensthorpe nature reserve near Fakenham in December.

This couple, who have built a lodge on the River Wensum, were the first wild beavers recorded in Norfolk since the native species was hunted to extinction in England at the beginning of the 16th century.

How they got to the Wensum remains a mystery. Although beavers have re-established themselves in the English countryside since 2015, the nearest population of wild beavers is thought to be more than 130 miles away, on the River Stour in Kent.

Some suspect the breeding pair were illegally released by conservation activists, a practice known as beaver bombing which Pensthorpe does not support, said the reserve’s manager, Richard Spowage.

However, he welcomed the arrival of the “very playful” kits, which are thought to be about three months old. “It’s amazing,” he said.

Viewing camera trap footage and discovering the kits had been born were moments of intense joy, he added.

“We initially saw a single young one with a parent, just pottering around, doing little beaver things, chewing on little bits of branch and leaf. And then, in a later piece of footage, it went off … and suddenly it came running back, and a second kit was running after it.”

The kits appear to enjoy feeding on willow and water mint, but not everything on the menu in Norfolk has proved a hit. “One got stung by a nettle, we think, because it reacted really suddenly, jumped back and started shaking its face.”

They are already becoming very independent, and have been learning how to dive into the river and tailslap its surface to make a big bang when they want to scare off a predator. “We’ve got footage of an adult tailslapping against an otter … and one of the little ones is able to do that now, too.”

Although the beavers live in a secret, inaccessible location in the nature reserve, they may expand their territory and become more visible to visitors in the future, he said.

The birth of the kits presents a conundrum, because they will have no mates to breed with in the future except their parents and siblings. “You can’t have just one family in the river system,” said Spowage. “You need a wider genetic pool.”

The reserve is now crowdfunding so that it can apply to the government advisory body, Natural England , for permission to legally introduce more wild beavers into the Wensum, which feeds into the Norfolk Broads.

It will be an expensive project, involving studies of the river system, staff training and discussions with multiple stakeholders, but Spowage is hoping all hurdles can be overcome so Norfolk’s first family of wild beavers can...
body.zh: 500 多年来，诺福克首次诞生了野生海狸幼崽。 这对新生儿是两只自由生活的海狸的后代，它们于 12 月神秘地抵达费克纳姆附近的彭斯索普自然保护区。 这对夫妇在温瑟姆河上建造了一座小屋，他们是自 16 世纪初英国本土海狸物种被猎杀至灭绝以来，在诺福克有记录的第一批野生海狸。 他们如何到达温苏姆仍然是个谜。尽管海狸自 2015 年以来已在英国乡村重新定居，但最近的野生海狸种群据信位于 130 多英里外的肯特郡斯图尔河上。 保护区经理理查德·斯波瓦奇 (Richard Spowage) 表示，一些人怀疑这对正在繁殖的海狸是被保护活动人士非法放生的，这种做法被称为海狸爆炸，彭斯索普并不支持这种做法。 不过，他对这些“非常好玩”的套件的到来表示欢迎，这些套件被认为已经有三个月大了。 “这太棒了，”他说。 他补充说，观看相机陷阱镜头并发现套件已经诞生是非常快乐的时刻。 “我们最初看到一只幼崽和父母在一起，只是闲逛，做一些海狸的小事，咀嚼一些树枝和树叶。然后，在后来的一段镜头中，它爆炸了……突然它跑了回来，第二只幼崽在后面追赶它。” 这些幼崽似乎很喜欢吃柳树和水薄荷，但诺福克菜单上的所有食物并不是都受欢迎。 “我们认为，其中一个是被荨麻蜇了，因为它反应非常突然，向后跳了一步，开始摇脸。” 它们已经变得非常独立，并且一直在学习如何潜入河中，并在想要吓跑捕食者时如何用尾部拍打河面以发出大爆炸。 “我们有一个成年水獭用尾巴拍打水獭的镜头……其中一只小水獭现在也能做到这一点。” 他说，虽然海狸生活在自然保护区一个秘密的、难以进入的地方，但它们可能会扩大它们的领地，并在未来变得更加容易被游客看到。 这些幼崽的诞生带来了一个难题，因为除了父母和兄弟姐妹之外，它们将来将没有伴侣可以繁殖。 “河流系统中不可能只有一个家庭，”斯波瓦奇说。 “你需要一个更广泛的基因库。” 该保护区目前正在进行众筹，以便可以向政府咨询机构“自然英格兰”申请许可，合法地将更多野生海狸引入温苏姆河，该河水流入诺福克湖区。 这将是一个耗资巨大的项目，涉及河流系统研究、员工培训以及与多个利益相关者的讨论，但 Spowage 希望能够克服所有障碍，以便诺福克的第一个野生海狸家族能够……

summary.en: 27 August 1926: Air-pilots report seeing wasps and small green flies almost a mile-high in the sky The report by experienced air-pilots of a wasp at 6,000 feet and small green flies – probably aphides – at 4,000 should make us realise how little we know of the habits of the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: 27 August 1926 : Air-pilots report seeing wasps and small green flies almost a mile-high in the sky The report by experienced air-pilots of a wasp at 6,000 feet and small green flies – probably aphides – at 4,000 should make us realise how little we know of the habits of the common creatures which we, boastfully, think we understand. Who would imagine that a wasp could ascend so high! It has proved that it can, but what did it go up for? A certain town-tip that I pass occasionally is a great place for wasps; they swarm over the rags, paper, tins, and rubbish of all kinds, and undoubtedly find much that for their grubs is fattening food in what man has thrown away as useless. Probably the old meat and fruit tins, jam pots too, are mines of treasure for these busy wasps. But surely no wasp expects to find a town-tip up in the sky, nor can it be worth the labour of ascent to that altitude in the hope of finding winged game, though the wasp is an excellent fly-catcher. The mother or queen wasps are busy laying eggs, so that cannot have tempted a drone to seek a mate in the upper air. Nuptial flight may explain the swarm of green flies at a great height; many insects ascend when they are stirred by amorous impulse, and high flight must influence distribution. A strong wind would carry them far from their original home, and doubtless many insect hordes are swept out to sea and trouble us no more. Continue reading...
body.zh: 1926 年 8 月 27 日：飞行员报告称在几乎一英里高的天空中看到了黄蜂和小绿蝇。经验丰富的飞行员报告称在 6,000 英尺高空发现了黄蜂，在 4,000 英尺高处发现了小绿蝇（可能是蚜虫），这应该让我们意识到，我们对这些我们自以为了解的常见生物的习性知之甚少。谁能想到黄蜂能飞得这么高！事实证明可以，但是它涨起来是为了什么？我偶尔经过的某个城镇尖端是黄蜂的好地方。它们成群结队地爬过破布、纸张、罐头盒和各种垃圾，毫无疑问，它们在人类丢弃的无用物品中发现了许多让它们的幼虫增肥的食物。对于这些忙碌的黄蜂来说，旧的肉类和水果罐头、果酱罐可能都是宝藏。但毫无疑问，没有黄蜂期望在天空中找到城镇的顶端，也不值得为了寻找有翅膀的猎物而费力爬到那个高度，尽管黄蜂是出色的捕蝇者。黄蜂妈妈或蜂王正忙于产卵，因此不可能诱使雄蜂在高空寻找配偶。婚飞或许可以解释为什么绿蝇会飞到很高的地方。许多昆虫在受到爱情冲动的刺激时就会上升，高飞必然会影响分布。一阵强风会将它们吹离原来的家园，毫无疑问，许多昆虫群会被卷入大海，不再打扰我们。继续阅读...

body.en: Shadow of Earth likely to make moon glow red before dawn on 28 August The early hours of Friday 28 August will reward very early risers in the UK, Europe and Africa with a fine lunar eclipse. Though not quite a total eclipse, it will transform the moon into a dramatic sight as dawn approaches. The partial eclipse begins at 3.33am BST, when the moon’s familiar full disc begins to disappear behind the shadow of the Earth. By the time the eclipse reaches its greatest extent, shortly after 5.10am, only a thin sliver of the moon will remain in direct sunlight. The rest is likely to glow a muted coppery red as sunlight bent into the Earth’s shadow and filtered through its atmosphere reaches the lunar surface. Continue reading...

title.en: Protein degradation rate helps explain why humans develop more slowly than mice
title.zh: 蛋白质降解率有助于解释为什么人类发育比小鼠慢

summary.en: Humans develop at a slower rate than other mammalian species, like mice, but scientists are still trying to understand the molecular basis of these differences. Now, researchers from the Ebisuya Group at EMBL Barcelona and PoL-TU Dresden and from the Savitski Team at EMBL...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Humans develop at a slower rate than other mammalian species, like mice, but scientists are still trying to understand the molecular basis of these differences. Now, researchers from the Ebisuya Group at EMBL Barcelona and PoL-TU Dresden and from the Savitski Team at EMBL Heidelberg show that across 4,000 proteins shared between humans and mice, there is a clear tendency for protein degradation in humans to be slower than in mice.
body.zh: 人类的发育速度比小鼠等其他哺乳动物物种慢，但科学家仍在试图了解这些差异的分子基础。现在，来自 EMBL 巴塞罗那和 PoL-TU 德累斯顿的 Ebisuya 小组以及 EMBL 海德堡的 Savitski 团队的研究人员表明，在人类和小鼠之间共享的 4,000 种蛋白质中，人类的蛋白质降解速度明显慢于小鼠。

title.en: Could teaching assistants be an overlooked teacher pipeline? New research says yes
title.zh: 助教能否成为被忽视的教师输送渠道？新研究称答案是肯定的

summary.en: New research from UNC-Chapel Hill indicates that teaching assistants are a significant and effective source for recruiting and retaining teachers. The study found that nearly one in five new teachers in North Carolina previously worked as teaching assistants and perform comparably to other early-career educators.
summary.zh: 北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校的最新研究表明，助教是招聘和留住教师的一个重要且有效的来源。这项研究发现，北卡罗来纳州近五分之一的新教师曾担任助教，并且他们的表现与其他早期职业教师相当。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

As school districts continue searching for ways to recruit and retain teachers, new research from UNC-Chapel Hill suggests one promising pipeline may already be in classrooms: teaching assistants.

A new statewide study from the Education Policy Initiative at Carolina (EPIC) found that nearly 1 in 5 beginning teachers in North Carolina previously worked as teaching assistants.

Researchers also found that these former TAs perform just as well as other early-career teachers—and are significantly more likely to remain in the profession through their second and third years.

The findings also suggest the TA-to-teacher pipeline could help address other workforce needs. Former TAs are more likely to be teachers of color and to hold special education licenses, strengthening areas where many districts face persistent shortages.

Kevin C. Bastian et al, Pathways and Outcomes for Early-Career Teachers With Teaching Assistant Experience, Educational Policy (2026). DOI: 10.1177/08959048261461454

title.en: Collaborative drawing offers new insights into how strangers become friends
title.zh: 协作绘画为陌生人如何成为朋友提供了新的见解

summary.en: The closer two people grow, the more alike their brains work—or so the assumption goes. Two ETH Zurich studies challenge this idea by examining the brain activity of younger and older adults who drew together over several weeks. Despite growing closer, the similarity of their...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The closer two people grow, the more alike their brains work—or so the assumption goes. Two ETH Zurich studies challenge this idea by examining the brain activity of younger and older adults who drew together over several weeks. Despite growing closer, the similarity of their brain activity did not simply increase.

What happens in the brain when two people engage in joint creative activity and build a new relationship with one another in the process? ETH cognitive scientist Ryssa Moffat investigated this question. She is a postdoctoral researcher at the Social Brain Sciences Lab within the Chair of Cognitive and Social Neuroscience.

Her study has now been published in the journal PLOS Biology . The setting was as follows: Over a period of six weeks, 61 pairs met six times to draw together. The participants came from a younger age group (18 to 35 years) and an older age group (70 to 85 years) and were divided into 31 cross-generational pairs and 30 pairs of the same age.

At the outset, the participants did not know each other and first had to become familiar with one another. At each session, the pairs first drew individually on separate sheets of paper, then drew together twice on a single sheet of paper. They were free to decide whether to take turns or draw simultaneously. They were allowed to converse throughout the session but were instructed to remain silent while drawing.

At each session, the researchers recorded participants' brain activity with wearable brain sensors. This enabled the researchers to investigate how the process of getting to know one another was reflected in the pairs' brain activity. At the same time, the mobile sensors ensured that participants could move and respond to each other naturally, as in everyday life, without distorting the recorded signals.

The similarity of brain activity was particularly crucial for the ETH researchers: To what extent do the brains of two people synchronize during an encounter? And how does this synchronization change over the course of repeated sessions? The focus was not on whether a pattern of brain activity corresponds to a specific subjective feeling such as liking or irritation.

Moffat was interested in what researchers call " inter-brain synchrony ": When people perform a shared task such as drawing, each person's brain reacts continuously to the other person's actions—and the brains can be said to be "synchronized" when similar changes in brain activity occur simultaneously in both people.

Previous studies on inter-brain synchrony suggested that the activity patterns of two brains become increasingly...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 两个人的关系越亲密，他们的大脑就越相似——至少是这样的假设。苏黎世联邦理工学院的两项研究通过检查几周内聚集在一起的年轻人和老年人的大脑活动来挑战这一观点。尽管越来越接近，但他们大脑活动的相似性并没有简单地增加。 当两个人进行共同的创造性活动并在此过程中彼此建立一种新的关系时，大脑会发生什么？ ETH 认知科学家 Ryssa Moffat 研究了这个问题。她是社会脑科学实验室的博士后研究员，担任认知和社会神经科学系主任。 她的研究现已发表在《PLOS Biology》杂志上。设定如下：在六周的时间里，61对组合进行了六次碰头抽奖。参与者来自较年轻的年龄组（18至35岁）和较年长的年龄组（70至85岁），并分为31对跨代和30对同龄。 一开始，参与者互不相识，首先要互相熟悉。在每次训练中，两人首先在不同的纸上单独画画，然后在一张纸上一起画两次。他们可以自由决定是轮流画还是同时画。他们被允许在整个会议期间交谈，但被要求在绘画时保持沉默。 在每次会议中，研究人员都用可穿戴大脑传感器记录参与者的大脑活动。这使得研究人员能够调查彼此了解的过程如何反映在两人的大脑活动中。同时，移动传感器确保参与者可以像日常生活一样自然地移动和相互响应，而不会扭曲记录的信号。 大脑活动的相似性对于苏黎世联邦理工学院的研究人员来说尤其重要：两个人的大脑在相遇时的同步程度如何？在重复会话的过程中，这种同步会如何变化？重点不在于大脑活动模式是否对应于特定的主观感觉，例如喜欢或刺激。 莫法特对研究人员所说的“脑间同步”很感兴趣：当人们执行绘画等共同任务时，每个人的大脑都会对另一个人的动作做出持续的反应——当两个人的大脑活动同时发生类似的变化时，可以说大脑是“同步的”。 先前关于大脑间同步的研究表明，两个大脑的活动模式变得越来越......

title.en: France links sharp rise in drownings to heatwaves
title.zh: 法国将溺水人数急剧上升与热浪联系起来

summary.en: A government minister says people have been taking risks by going into the water, with 301 deaths since 19 June.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
France has seen 301 drownings since 19 June, a government minister has said, linking the sharp rise in deaths from last year to a series of prolonged heatwaves.

Sports and Youth Minister Marina Ferrari told France Inter radio the number of deaths - a 14% hike on 2025 - was a "tragic toll".

France, Spain and Italy have all been hit by heatwaves that have triggered massive wildfires that have scorched thousands of hectares of land this summer.

Ferrari said people had been taking risks by going into the water, adding: "Many deadly accidents have occurred in areas that are not authorised or supervised for swimming."

She said a number of the drownings were recorded in "open water, in canals for example".

Ferrari said the government was working with regional authorities "to improve swimming areas and make things safer".

Speaking on Friday, she added that "many drownings, particularly among the elderly, occurred in individual pools".

The minister said that sudden immersion in cold water on a hot day could cause shock, and that in some cases "people can also exceed their physical capabilities".

In June, Ferrari warned that too many people were trying to cool off in rivers and canals without necessarily taking the risks into account.

Climate change is driving up global average temperatures, making heatwaves more frequent and intense.

This has been felt acutely in Europe, which is the fastest warming continent, heating up twice as fast as the global average, according to the Copernicus climate service. , external

A heatwave in June saw a nuclear power plant in south-west France temporarily shut down because water temperatures in the River Garonne topped 28C. Under French laws, water used to cool the reactors at the Golfech plant must not exceed that temperature.

Some monuments like the Eiffel Tower also decided to close early because of the high temperatures in Paris during the heatwave.

The dry conditions also saw wildfires spread across France, with Gironde, around the city of Bordeaux in the south-west of the country, being the worse affected area, with more than 200,000 people being forced from their homes in late July.

France has logged 7,300 excess deaths between late May and 22 July, according to provisional figures from the public health authorities.
body.zh: 一位政府部长表示，自 6 月 19 日以来，法国已发生 301 起溺水事件，将去年死亡人数急剧上升与一系列长期热浪联系起来。 体育和青年部长玛丽娜·法拉利 (Marina Ferrari) 告诉法国国际米兰电台，死亡人数比 2025 年增加 14%，这是一个“悲惨的数字”。 今年夏天，法国、西班牙和意大利都遭受了热浪袭击，引发了大规模野火，烧毁了数千公顷土地。 法拉利表示，人们一直冒险下水，并补充道：“许多致命事故发生在未经授权或监督的游泳区域。” 她说，许多溺水事件是在“开放水域，例如运河”中发生的。 法拉利表示，政府正在与地方当局合作“改善游泳区并使事情变得更安全”。 她在周五发表讲话时补充说，“许多溺水事件，特别是老年人溺水事件，都发生在个别泳池中”。 这位部长表示，在炎热的天气里突然浸入冷水中可能会导致休克，并且在某些情况下“人们也会超出其身体承受能力”。 六月，法拉利警告说，太多人试图在河流和运河中降温，而没有考虑到风险。 气候变化正在推高全球平均气温，使热浪更加频繁和强烈。 根据哥白尼气候服务机构的数据，欧洲对此有着强烈的感受，欧洲是变暖最快的大陆，升温速度是全球平均水平的两倍。 , 外部 6月的热浪导致法国西南部的一座核电站暂时关闭，因为加龙河水温高达28摄氏度。根据法国法律，用于冷却戈尔菲什核电站反应堆的水不得超过该温度。 由于热浪期间巴黎气温较高，埃菲尔铁塔等一些古迹也决定提前关闭。 干燥的气候还导致野火蔓延到法国各地，其中该国西南部波尔多市周围的吉伦特省是受灾最严重的地区，7月下旬已有超过20万人被迫离开家园。 根据公共卫生当局的临时数据，5月下旬至7月22日期间，法国已有7,300人超额死亡。

title.zh: 阿尔茨海默病的一个主要风险基因可能会在症状出现前数年使脑细胞萎缩

summary.en: Researchers have uncovered a possible reason why the Alzheimer’s risk gene APOE4 can disrupt the brain long before memory problems begin. In mice, APOE4 increased a protein called Nell2, shrinking neurons and making memory circuits unusually active. That early hyperactivity...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Researchers have uncovered a possible reason why the Alzheimer’s risk gene APOE4 can disrupt the brain long before memory problems begin. In mice, APOE4 increased a protein called Nell2, shrinking neurons and making memory circuits unusually active. That early hyperactivity predicted worse memory later in life. Reducing Nell2 in adult mice reversed the abnormal changes, raising hopes for a new way to intervene before Alzheimer’s progresses.
body.zh: 研究人员发现了阿尔茨海默氏症风险基因 APOE4 可以在记忆问题出现之前很久就破坏大脑的一个可能原因。在小鼠中，APOE4 增加了一种名为 Nell2 的蛋白质，使神经元缩小并使记忆回路异常活跃。早期的过度活跃预示着日后记忆力会变差。减少成年小鼠中的 Nell2 可以逆转异常变化，从而为在阿尔茨海默氏症进展之前进行干预的新方法带来了希望。

summary.en: Researchers at CERN have created microscopic versions of the early Universe by colliding surprisingly small atomic nuclei at nearly the speed of light. The collisions produced quark-gluon plasma, the ultra-hot matter believed to have filled the cosmos shortly after the Big Bang....

body.en: Researchers at CERN have created microscopic versions of the early Universe by colliding surprisingly small atomic nuclei at nearly the speed of light. The collisions produced quark-gluon plasma, the ultra-hot matter believed to have filled the cosmos shortly after the Big Bang. Even more intriguingly, the particles left behind reveal the shape of the nuclei that created them, offering a new way to probe both nuclear physics and the Universe’s earliest moments.
body.zh: 欧洲核子研究中心的研究人员通过以接近光速的速度碰撞令人惊讶的小原子核，创造了早期宇宙的微观版本。碰撞产生了夸克-胶子等离子体，这种超热物质据信在大爆炸后不久就充满了宇宙。更有趣的是，留下的粒子揭示了产生它们的原子核的形状，为探测核物理和宇宙最早的时刻提供了一种新方法。
